name: Flamme Volcanique
description: Pyroclaste projetant des roches volcaniques en fusion sur les cibles au sol avec une précision destructrice.

loadout.armor_outfit: Tribal heat-resistant cloak of tattered anti-radiation tarps, layered with rusted metal plates, exposed tumorous flesh bearing luminescent yellow nodules, and a fused high-tech gauntlet housing the magma cannon
loadout.arsenal: Integrated magma cannon relic: a sleek, intact high-tech plasma-ignited volcanic launcher grafted into the forearm, glowing with a cosmic blue energy core, capable of hurling molten rocks with pinpoint accuracy

attitude.behavior: Stands on a cracked basaltic ledge, arm thrust forward, a glowing boulder of molten rock already released, smoke and ash swirling around the figure, one foot braced for recoil
attitude.emotion: Fierce, unwavering determination; eyes glowing with radioactive yellow, a grimace of savage focus

palette_names.name: Ash Gray
palette_names.role: ruins, ash rain, and metal debris

scenography.setting: Barren volcanic wasteland dotted with jagged ruins, a fissure spewing ash, cracked earth bathed in molten glow
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: falling ash, drifting smoke, embers swirling, occasional lava droplets, subtle blue energy sparks from the weapon
